extraction: Unmodified CDS ReadMe for catalogue J/ApJ/914/123.
note: Authoritative column definitions. Key facts recorded from it: HRV uses 1000 km/s as a NULL SENTINEL and e_HRV uses 10000; dSF is 'Distance to the star estimated by STREAMFINDER' and is therefore MODEL-DEPENDENT (STREAMFINDER searches for stars consistent with a common orbit in an ASSUMED Galactic potential); r_HRV=0 means no velocity measurement and occurs 5275 times out of 5960, leaving 685 stars with a velocity. The per-reference counts in the ReadMe (15/1/6/44/135/86/155/5/7/6/44/181) sum to 685 and were verified against the downloaded table exactly.
